definitions: To deal with a difficult situation directly and courageously.
To confront a problem head-on without hesitation.
examples: She decided to take the bull by the horns and confront her boss about the unfair workload.
It's time to take the bull by the horns and address the financial issues.
Instead of avoiding the problem, he chose to take the bull by the horns.
lemma: to take the bull by the horns
source: to take the bull by the horns
